meta.label: Simulation
meta.note: Fictional grid operator districts for the demo. Not real network operators - the names are deliberately obvious placeholders. Months are illustrative.

districts.name: Demo DSO Nord
districts.note: Writes a static cap only - one number for the whole year.

districts.name: Demo DSO West
districts.note: Writes a static cap only, and the queue is the longest of the four.

districts.name: Demo DSO Ost
districts.note: Writes a seasonal time-of-day cap agreed up front.

districts.name: Demo DSO Sued
districts.note: Writes fully dynamic day-ahead limits, and connects soonest.
